resources.string: Review the driving assistance controls your vehicle may offer.
Open Vehicle → Driving assistance. On a compatible vehicle, enable TLC before NOA.
If a control is unavailable in Guest, check what the factory page asks for. Follow its prompts for vehicle account, training or service access.
Read the head-unit software details and cached factory requests. Check access and assistance status in the vehicle.
Factory settings requested. Check assistance status in the vehicle.
Reading factory software and cached values…
The factory cache supplied %1$d of %2$d fields. Controller confirmation is still required.
The factory settings provider is unavailable. The report records which packages and menus are visible.
This software does not offer a trusted, readable factory cache. The report contains the available package details.
The factory cache check could not finish. The report contains the reason.
Write the exact control name, the message the factory page shows and the account it asks for. Keep personal data and QR codes out. The note is saved with the report and stays in the report.
Could not copy the details. Read them from the saved report.
The report could not be prepared or saved. Try again.
A browser is needed to open the owner manual.
Could not open the selected menu. Try opening the vehicle menu from the factory panel.
Choose Driving assistance in the general vehicle menu.

In the factory menu, check whether an option appears, whether your account can use it, whether a change is kept and whether the assistant is ready or active. Cached requests only show what the factory software asked for.
